title: RWB-S7-E6013-APP: the scan slice has no plan row for its four consumed contracts, its rule kit, its ACE read, its inbox and its schedule, and no table or list of values holds the scan
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R5.7, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6013-APP; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-013; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A1.3, A1.4, A2.1 and Requirements served; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.0 to T3.3, T4, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-01 to R-WO-04 and the sheet Route sets; Batch and Scheduling Design v4, JOB-16; Event and Messaging Design v4, EV-24 and EV-26
description: (1) The plan gives H = RWB-S7-E6013-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads the rwb-case case list, the rwb-source-data batch status and balance and the rwb-decision package and answers the rwb-case case move, so four consumed rows have no plan row. (2) DP-04 is absent although the step evaluates the WO route set of 51 rules over 27 states. (3) DP-05 is absent although R-WO-01 tests the ALS load in v_ace_batch_status, a view only rwb-source-data may read. (4) DP-09 is absent although the service owns topic rwb.writeoff.events.v1 with EV-24 and the step consumes the ACE data-ready fact (EV-26). (5) DP-10 is absent although the ownership rows give S7 one job, JOB-16 write-off scan, and the Schedule that replaces Quartz is therefore part of this deliverable. (6) No table and no list of values holds the scan: write_off carries no cut-off date and no scan reference, S7 owns one table only, TSD S7 T3.2 is empty, and API Specification v4 answers WriteOffScan with id, cutOffDate, eligible, heldOut and status. (7) DF-FIN-014 tax_criteria_met and DF-FIN-020 recovered_after are required at insert while FEAT-WOF-02 (RWB-S7-E6014-APP) writes the tax result and the post charge-off recovery story writes the recovered amount. (8) The legacy Data table names recovery_case, decision_log_entry and rule_row, none of which this service may read or write, and the legacy endpoints carry the monolith base. (9) 'Both tracks' is named by the rule and by the route set's end states, never defined, and MSG-S7-001 is the only message of the two holds while R-WO-02 raises an incident with no message ID. (10) The split plan carries no requirement id for this slice.
evidence: split plan slice RWB-S7-E6013-APP with three H rows and empty C, I and X; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-04, DP-05, DP-09 and DP-10 rows; context pack ownership rows (table write_off, 2 REST operations, event EV-24, job JOB-16, workflow WriteOffWorkflow) and Temporal and Drools slide 12 (Scheduled job: JOB-16 write-off scan); TSD S7 T3.1, T3.2 (empty table) and T4; API Specification v4, WriteOffScan; Batch and Scheduling Design v4, JOB-16; Event and Messaging Design v4, EV-26; FSD S7 A2.1.3.1; legacy RWB-E6-013 Data, Endpoints, Acceptance criteria and Guardrails
area: Dependency, ownership, data and requirement trace
proposed: Keep the plan's H, C, I and X rows as they stand; record the rwb-case, rwb-source-data and rwb-decision rows as class C in fact with their placeholders; record RWB-PLT-E1072-CON with RWB-P7-E1073-CON as the rule kit, RWB-PLT-TE006-CON as the outbox and inbox library and RWB-PLT-E1071-CON as the Scheduled job kit; declare the JOB-16 Schedule and the ACE data-ready trigger in the story and register neither; decide with the owners whether the scan needs a table or columns of its own, and publish a list of values for the write-off state before the DB story; write tax_criteria_met and recovered_after as the later stories' and confirm the required flags with the DB story; adopt REQ-S7-001 for traceability

title: RWB-S7-E6013-CON: the consumed operation names, the case boundary element, the event names, the schedule parameters and the list of values of rwb-writeoff have no published baseline
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S7-E6013-CON; context pack S7 rwb-writeoff; legacy RWB-E6-013; FSD S7 Write-off and recovery v3 A2.1.2, A2.1.3.1, A2.1.4.4 and Screens; TSD S7 Write-off and recovery v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2 and T-A.1 and T-A.2; API Specification v4, ScanRequest, WriteOffScan and WriteOff; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-WO-01 to R-WO-04; Batch and Scheduling Design v4, JOB-16; Event and Messaging Design v4, EV-24 and EV-26
description: (1) The rwb-case, rwb-source-data and rwb-decision rows name no operation, so four consumed rows carry a placeholder. (2) No source publishes a REST operation that moves a case state on behalf of a stage, and the S7 row of the connection matrix shows Temporal to P3 and P7 rather than a REST read of the case, so the case list and the case move are declared with the placeholder. (3) TSD S7 T3.2 publishes no list of values, so no enumeration can be declared for the answer's status or for the write-off state and the vocabulary gap is carried. (4) TSD S7 T-A.2 gives error sets as status codes with no message ID per condition, so each condition is bound to a message of the legacy and FSD set. (5) T-A.2 publishes no required list for ScanRequest and WriteOffScan while API Specification v4 publishes one for WriteOff, so the requiredness of the request and the answer is stated as copied. (6) No table holds the scan answer and the ownership rows give S7 one table. (7) The target event names of EV-24 and EV-26 are not published in any catalogue, only the naming rule of Template and Rules §R4 gives their form. (8) The JOB-16 Schedule has no identifier, no hour and no definition of the third working day in any source. (9) The plan's C, I and X rows of this slice are empty while the contract declares four consumed rows.
evidence: TSD S7 T-A.1 operations API-S7-001 and API-S7-002, T-A.2 error lists of 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503 without message ids, T3.1 field list and T3.2 empty table; API Specification v4, ScanRequest, WriteOffScan and WriteOff (required list of the write-off only); context pack connection-matrix row S7 (Temporal to P7 and P8, REST and events to P1) and ownership rows (table write_off, 1 event, 1 job); Batch and Scheduling Design v4, JOB-16; legacy RWB-E6-013 messages MSG-S7-001, MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P4-002 and MSG-P7-003
area: Contract surface, interface names and vocabulary
proposed: Publish the baseline with the placeholders, bind every error condition to one message ID of section 14, declare the case boundary as the child workflow's input, signals and stage outcome, declare the trigger without registering it, confirm the four operation names and the two event names with their owners before the tag, settle the scan table and the list of values with the data owners, and record the tag date in the contract README
